snippet.title: How to deal with ultra-fast zombies? The Last Camp officially announced
snippet.description: Published by NiuGamer and developed by PARADOW, the zombie-themed action shooter The Last Camp is confirmed to launch on July 11 for PS5, Xbox, and the Windows Store, supporting local multiplayer co-op and Xbox Play Anywhere functionality.
